notes:
Account background:
- Prism Crest SupportGrid: cloud-native contact center platform used by retail & travel verticals. HQ Boston, growing EU customer base (legal pushing residency).
- Primary pain: service-impacting spikes (holiday peaks, product launches). Queues build quickly -> SLA breaches and agent overload.

Use-case / requirements summary:
- Workloads: live agent assist (short latencies), async ticket summarization, automated tool-calls (CRM updates, escalate), reranking for search.
- Peak targets: handle 8k-12k concurrent conversational sessions during promos; maintain median agent-assist latency < 350ms and p95 < 900ms.
- Throughput: bursts of ~18k TTK (tokens/min) across fleet during peak windows. Expect sustained spikes 10-20 mins then cool-down.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for predictability for peak windows (reserved + burst) but want transparent unit economics.
- Model preferences: open model baseline (quantized), fallback small-fast model for degraded capacity; prefer GPU-backed Dedicated with automatic fallback routing.

Security & compliance:
- Need SSO/SAML integration, SOC2 evidence, audit logging, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal flagged retention policy: 6 months for conversational logs.
